articles.title: Philippines raises Mayon volcano alert following explosive eruption
articles.description: ASTANA - The Philippines has raised the alert level for Mayon volcano to Level 3 following a “moderately explosive” eruption on Friday, prompting authorities to call for the evacuation of residents living within a six-kilometer radius of the volcano, a wire service reported.

articles.title: These are the races real estate is watching in South Florida
articles.description: Floridians will choose their next governor and U.S. senator on Election Day, but their ballots will also include a number of key races and referendums tied to real estate. That includes the proposed statewide property tax referendum, which requires 60 percent voter approval, and measures tied to city-owned land across South Florida. These are the races we’re watching.
